steps.does: Parse the request, then search flights, return flights and hotels.
Code ranks the options by the travel policy and keeps the best three.
The model writes a short letter that explains the ranking.
Code checks policy, totals, flight numbers, amounts and names, and that the letter says nothing is booked.
Send the letter and ask to book the first option. The booking waits for an Admin.
Save the options and the letter on the request record.
